lesson: First card back after the international break. Last card finished one win and one loss for +$2.53. After a break, form lines are stale and prices are sharp, so today's card is small: two handicap plays where the market looks a touch too harsh on the underdog, and everything else is a pass.

matches.analysis: Chelsea are the favourites, but the straight-win price is short and Bournemouth have been hard to beat. With +0.75 we win if Bournemouth win or draw, and lose only half our stake if they lose by one goal. Only a defeat by two or more goals loses the full stake. Over 2.5 goals and both-teams-to-score were both priced fairly, so the handicap is where the value sits. Moderate stake because the break makes form harder to read.

A near coin-flip match at home for Watford. The handicap gives us our money back on a draw and wins if Watford win. The home side is slightly underpriced against the visitors. Smaller stake because the price is not big and the Championship is volatile.
Checked match odds, handicap, goals and both-teams-to-score. All four are priced about where they should be, so there is no edge worth risking money on.
Monaco are favourites, but the price already reflects it. The handicap and goals markets offer no gap in our favour.
Lille win is too short to back, and the handicap line removes the value. Passing.
Two unpredictable sides coming off a break. All markets look fairly priced, so we stay out.

matches.match: Alaves vs Atletico Madrid / Real Madrid vs Villarreal
matches.analysis: Both favourites are priced short, and the handicap and goals markets do not offer an edge. Passing on both.

avoid: Short-priced favourites such as Bayern, Barcelona, Inter and PSG at prices under 1.40. The return does not justify the risk.
